name: Tvg_Colorspace
brief: Enumeration specifying the methods of combining the 8-bit color channels into 32-bit color.

members.name: TVG_COLORSPACE_ABGR8888
members.brief: The channels are joined in the order: alpha, blue, green, red. Colors are alpha-premultiplied.

members.name: TVG_COLORSPACE_ARGB8888
members.brief: The channels are joined in the order: alpha, red, green, blue. Colors are alpha-premultiplied.

members.name: TVG_COLORSPACE_ABGR8888S
members.brief: The channels are joined in the order: alpha, blue, green, red. Colors are un-alpha-premultiplied. (since 0.13)

members.name: TVG_COLORSPACE_ARGB8888S
members.brief: The channels are joined in the order: alpha, red, green, blue. Colors are un-alpha-premultiplied. (since 0.13)

members.name: TVG_COLORSPACE_GRAYSCALE8
members.brief: Single channel, 1 byte per pixel 8-bit grayscale. (since 1.1)

members.name: TVG_COLORSPACE_UNKNOWN
members.brief: Unknown channel data. This is reserved for an initial ColorSpace value. (since 1.0)
